_comment: PVT corner set consumed by sim/harness/gridspec.py (schema 1: process[], temperature_c[], supply_v{}; every other key is documentation the runner ignores).

Filled by the target spec (issue #2, spec/target-spec.md) and re-derived for the 1.2 V thin-oxide rail of spec/decisions/0007-rail-1p2v-thin-oxide.md (operator ruling 2026-10-20). Status follows the ratification record named in ratified_by: until that record is merged by a human the set is PROPOSED, and no result graded on it is a ratified-spec result.

process[] are section names of the pinned PDK's libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerMOSlv.lib (IHP-Open-PDK v0.3.0, sim/pdk.json): mos_tt, mos_ss, mos_ff, mos_sf, mos_fs. The lv library is the one the spec's device flavor (sg13_lv_*, 0007 decision 1) needs; a bench names it in its base request's models.lib. The *_mismatch sections are Monte Carlo, not corners, and are selected by the harness's --mc-vary / --control-process flags.

supply_v.Vdd is the value of the voltage source named Vdd in a bench deck (klt sim alters it by name, as the smoke decks already name theirs). 1.08 / 1.20 / 1.32 V is the spec's 1.2 V +/-10 % rail (row 9); the PDK rates the lv devices at VGS <= 1.65 V @ 125 C (SG13G2_os_process_spec.pdf Rev. 1.2 sections 2.1-2.2) with a model maximum drain-source voltage of 1.5 V (cornerMOSlv.lib header), so every corner is inside the rating. The rows are crossed with process x temperature_c: 5 x 3 x 3 = 45 corners, the full set the spec grades every pass/fail row over (0001 decision 7).

reduced_set is for fast iteration only and is never a recorded result (0001). The jitter row (row 6) runs at the same three corners, but by its own statement in spec/target-spec.md, not by reference to this key.
device_flavor: sg13_lv (1.2 V thin-oxide), models in cornerMOSlv.lib

reduced_set.use: fast iteration only; never recorded as a result

narrowing: none: full MOS x +/-10 % supply x -40..125 C cross product for every pass/fail row; the jitter row's 3-corner set is stated in the spec row itself
